message: What items do I need to hold? I can help gather your sugar cane, apple, bone, and gold too.
!startConversation("Andy_0", "You need iron_block, copper_block, heavy_weighted_pressure_plate, and lightning_rod. I need sugar cane, apple, bone, and gold. Please gather those if you can!")
You need iron_block, copper_block, heavy_weighted_pressure_plate, and lightning_rod. I need sugar cane, apple, bone, and gold. Please gather those if you can!
I’ll gather your ingredients first. !searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 128)
I’ll check the supply chests for our metals. !searchForBlock("chest", 128)
!viewChest
I’ll take enough iron and copper for my objectives. !takeFromChest("iron_ingot", 11)
!takeFromChest("copper_ingot", 12)
!craftRecipe("iron_block", 1)
!craftRecipe("copper_block", 1)
!craftRecipe("heavy_weighted_pressure_plate", 1)
!searchForBlock("chest", 128)
!craftRecipe("lightning_rod", 1)
!viewChest
!startConversation("Jill_0", "I finished my four targets. Your card says paper, golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. What do you have so far? I can help gather.")
I finished my four targets. Your card says paper, golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. What do you have so far? I can help gather.
!takeFromChest("sugar_cane", 12)
!inventory
Jill’s getting sugar cane; I’ll check the supply chest for the other ingredients. !viewChest
I’ve got 3 gold ingots, so we still need 5 more for your apple. I’ll check the other supply chests. !goToCoordinates(0, 65, 0, 2)
I’ll look for more gold and an apple in the supply chests. !viewChest
!goToCoordinates(30, 65, 0, 2)
!craftRecipe("bone_meal", 1)
!craftRecipe("paper", 1)
!inventory
!craftRecipe("sugar", 1)
!startConversation("Andy_0", "I crafted the paper and sugar. I still need 1 bone meal (one bone) and 5 more gold ingots for the golden apple—please let me know what you find.")
I crafted the paper and sugar. I still need 1 bone meal (one bone) and 5 more gold ingots for the golden apple—please let me know what you find.
I’ll check another chest for gold and an apple. !searchForBlock("chest", 128)
!viewChest
That chest only has iron and copper. I’ll search farther out for another one. !moveAway(64)
!searchForBlock("chest", 128)
!viewChest
!takeFromChest("bone", 1)
!craftRecipe("bone_meal", 1)
!startConversation("Andy_0", "This chest at (-15, 65, 7) has 4 bone and 6 beetroot; I took one bone. I’ll keep searching for gold to finish my golden apple.")
This chest at (-15, 65, 7) has 4 bone and 6 beetroot; I took one bone. I’ll keep searching for gold to finish my golden apple.

That chest has no gold or apple. Jill, have you found any other supply chests? I’m looking for gold and a bone. !startConversation("Jill_0", "That chest has no gold or apple. Have you found any other supply chests? I’m looking for gold and a bone.")
That chest has no gold or apple. Have you found any other supply chests? I’m looking for gold and a bone.
Found one chest at (-15, 65, 7); it had bone and beetroot, no gold or apple. I used the bone for bone meal. !searchForBlock("chest", 128)
!searchForBlock("chest", 128)
!searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 128)
I’ve got 3 gold ingots. I’ll check another part of the arena for supplies. !goToCoordinates(60,65,60,3)
I need 3 more gold ingots for my golden apple. Could you spare the 3 you found? I’ll keep searching for another chest too. !searchForBlock("chest", 128)
I’ve got 5 gold ingots and an apple, so I only need 3 more for the golden apple. !goToPlayer("Andy_0", 3)
!givePlayer("Jill_0", "gold_ingot", 3)
I gave Jill 3 gold ingots; she still needs 5 for the apple. I’ll search for more supplies. !searchForBlock("chest", 256)
!viewChest
!startConversation("Jill_0", "I gave you 3 gold ingots; you still need 5 more and an apple for the golden apple. Have you found either?")
I gave you 3 gold ingots; you still need 5 more and an apple for the golden apple. Have you found either?
I already had an apple and 8 gold ingots, so your 3 gave me enough. Crafting it now. !craftRecipe("golden_apple", 1)
The recipe needs a crafting table. I’ll head to the center and craft it. !searchForBlock("crafting_table", 128)
!craftRecipe("golden_apple", 1)
